facts.material: not stated (assumed brass / nickel-bronze cast and machined, typical for residential shower grates)
facts.function: covers the shower drain, lets wastewater pass and keeps debris out
facts.form: grate attached to a drain body, cast and further machined

gri_path: GRI 1: the grate is an article of base metal classified by its material; no chapter 84 heading applies (not a valve or tap), and heading 7324 sanitary ware covers articles such as sinks and basins, not drain grates
Assumed brass: heading 7419 other articles of copper; cast grates that are machined are advanced beyond 7419.20 'cast, not further worked' (per N327820)
GRI 6: 7419.80.50 other; statistical suffix .10 brass plumbing goods n.e.s.o.i.

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies if the grate is steel/stainless steel (e.g. linear stainless drain covers); material not stated
applies if the grate is plastic sanitary ware
cast copper articles not further worked; shower grates are normally machined/drilled after casting
sanitary ware of steel covers baths, shower bases and the like, not a drain grate; would only matter if steel

missing_facts: What material are the shower grates made of (brass/nickel bronze, stainless steel, plastic)?
If copper alloy: are they machined/further worked after casting?
classification.rationale: Shower grates are classified by their constituent material, and the description does not state it. NY N327820 (in force) classified a cast and machined brass (nickel bronze) shower grate used to drain wastewater in 7419.80.5010 as a brass plumbing good. That is the best guess here, but a stainless steel grate would fall in 7326.90.86.88 and a plastic one in 3922.90.00, so the material must be confirmed.
